newsitem.title: JAPAN: Konica shares jump on Kodak tie-up report.
newsitem.headline: Konica shares jump on Kodak tie-up report.

text.p: Shares in Konica Corp jumped on Wednesday morning, helped by a newspaper report that it is to supply high-speed digital copiers to Eastman Kodak Co which will be sold outside of Japan under the Kodak brand name, traders said.
The move will help boost Konica's copier business overseas, the report in the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Konica's share price soared 32 yen or 4.52 percent to 740 yen by 0040 GMT, making it the fourth-sharpest percentage gainer on the first section. Volume was 377,000 shares.
Konica later confirmed the newspaper report.
"The agreement is expected to increase annual sales of our overseas copier business by 12 billion to 13 billion yen from some 60 billion yen currently," a Konica spokeswoman said.
